title: Decentralized Strategies for Finite Population LQG Social Control: A Reinforcement Learning Approach
summary: This paper presents a novel model-free algorithm for the finite-population linear quadratic Gaussian (LQG) decentralized social control problem with multiplicative noise. The state and control weights in the cost functional are not limited to be positive semidefinite. For both finite-horizon and infinite-horizon cases, the goal is to obtain a social optimum by solving two algebraic Riccati equations (AREs), without requiring prior knowledge of the system matrices.
